steps.en: Add the Quick Start workflow to .github/workflows/security.yml with your Claude API key secret
steps.zh: 加上 workflow 文件，填好 API key 的 secret

steps.en: Make fork PRs wait for a maintainer before workflows run
steps.zh: 让外部贡献者的 PR 等维护者批准后才跑 workflow
steps.code: Require approval for all external contributors

steps.en: On each PR, Claude Code reads the changed files and reasons about them in context
steps.zh: 每个 PR 上，Claude Code 读改动的文件，结合上下文推理

steps.en: A filtering pass drops low-impact findings such as DoS, rate limiting and open redirects
steps.zh: 再过一遍过滤，丢掉 DoS、限流、开放重定向这类低影响发现

steps.en: Posts what is left as review comments on the exact lines, with severity and a fix
steps.zh: 把剩下的发现贴成行级评论，附严重度和修法

value.en: Logic-level vulnerabilities in a diff are flagged on the PR before merge, with no rules to write
value.zh: diff 里的逻辑层漏洞在合并前就标在 PR 上，不用自己写规则
